answer_1.quote: We train 1.5B parameter "XL" decoder‑only Transformer‑based language models ... We generate 100,000 samples, each up to 512 tokens ... For each generated token, we say the token is memorized if it is part of a 50‑token substring that is exactly contained in the training data.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text sequences (unprompted and prompted) used to measure memorization and perplexity

answer_2.quote: We computed the perplexity of our trained models on the validation sets of LM1B and Wiki‑40B ... Over 1% of the tokens emitted from a model trained on the original dataset are part of a 50‑token long sequence copied directly from the training dataset.
automatic_metrics: memorization rate (percentage of generated tokens that match training substrings)
